name: E. coli thymidylate synthase (TSase, ecTSase)
notes: Paper names no EC; EC from UniProt. Paper uses E. coli numbering; N177 (and C146, H147, R166, E58 named in text) match P0A884 with Met1 = 1. Full-length enzyme, no tag or truncation stated; mutant made by PCR mutagenesis, expressed in E. coli ΔthyA BL21(DE3). RCSB: 67 entities by accession P0A884, 68 by sequence identity >= 0.9; no entity carries N177S (only N177A: 1BQ1, 1BQ2, and the designed 4F2V); no entry cites 10.1021/acscatal.8b02554. Paper names 1TRG (WT), 1BQ1 (N177A), 1TSN (WT, used for QM/MM).

name: E. coli dihydrofolate reductase (EcDHFR, DHFR)
notes: Paper prints EC 1.5.1.3 (= UniProt). I14 matches P0ABQ4 numbering (Met1 = 1). Construct details (tags) only in ESI. 4QLE entity 1: mutation field I14A, sequence identical to P0ABQ4 otherwise (residues 1-159, no other difference); found by sequence search only (entity not mapped to P0ABQ4 in RCSB); 4QLE cites 10.1021/jp5059963, not this paper; no entry cites 10.1039/c0cc02988b. Paper modelled I14A in silico from WT 1RX2.

name: l-DHFR (light ecDHFR)
notes: Paper names no EC; EC from UniProt. Natural-abundance WT; synthetic ecDHFR gene in pJexpress411, expressed in E. coli BL21(DE3) (LB or M63 medium); no tag stated; MW 18.1 kDa. WT with very many PDB entries (165 entities by accession P0ABQ4, 182 by sequence identity >= 0.9), pdb left empty; paper names 1RX2 (Michaelis-complex mimic) and 1RX4 (product-complex mimic); RCSB sequences of 1RX2/1RX4 have D37 where P0ABQ4 has N37; no entry cites 10.1021/ja501936d.

name: h-DHFR (heavy ecDHFR)
notes: Isotopically labelled construct, treated separately: uniformly 13C, 15N and non-exchangeable 2H (98.3% enrichment by mass spectrometry; 20.1 vs 18.1 kDa); expressed in M63 medium in D2O with [U-13C6,1,2,3,4,5,6,6-2H7]glucose and [15N]NH4Cl, purified in H2O. Same sequence as WT; RCSB does not record isotope labelling and no full-text hit for a heavy ecDHFR; no entry cites 10.1021/ja501936d; pdb left empty. EC from UniProt.
